custody_telemetry.source: operator custody telemetry; not an independent provider audit

method.bootstrap: percentile95; resample W1 template clusters with replacement; same draws for all arms and alphas within row
method.disconnected: No added statistical cutoff: display asked/random and continuation trajectories together; no automatic disconnected verdict.
method.donor_baseline: donor steering uses donor alpha0; donor alpha0 minus own alpha0 is a separate replacement effect
method.monotonicity: nondecreasing seven-dose mean asked trajectory and positive slope; no sign flips or fitted tolerance
method.projection: row own probe projection one decoder layer after intervention; preanswer and mean true-answer positions retained separately
method.random_baseline: three seeded unit directions; empirical 95th percentile using linear interpolation
method.random_percentile_limitation: Only three direction slopes: the 95th percentile is sparse and is not a calibrated 95% hypothesis test or a random-direction population bound.
method.row_seed: seed plus fixed registered row index
method.slope: OLS of the seven paired alpha-minus-zero changes against alpha, with intercept; average per-item slopes

prediction.requirement: at least 3 of 4 state rows: all-seven-dose monotonic A-positive asked movement and own slope above empirical random q95
